definition.name: Mid-position three-port valve
definition.description: Separate heating and hot-water demand inputs select a conceptual mid-position valve state.

terminals.label: L
terminals.purpose: Line conductor: the alternating supply relative to neutral.

terminals.label: N
terminals.purpose: Neutral: the normal return path. It is not a protective conductor.

terminals.label: CH
terminals.purpose: Heating demand input, sensed relative to N. This requests conceptual valve travel; permanent L/N power and the end-position output are separate functions. Actual manufacturer wire colours and terminal schemes vary.

terminals.label: HW
terminals.purpose: Hot-water demand input, sensed relative to N. This requests conceptual valve travel; permanent L/N power and the end-position output are separate functions. Actual manufacturer wire colours and terminal schemes vary.

terminals.label: END
terminals.purpose: End-position output: a conceptual auxiliary contact connects permanent L to END after the represented valve reaches the requested operating position. A demand alone does not prove this output is available.

terminals.label: PE
terminals.purpose: Protective connection to the represented exposed conductive parts or protective network. It carries no intended normal load return and remains independent of switching the active conductors.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Operating mechanism
parts.purpose: The mechanism translates a handle, button, coil or control demand into an operating state.

parts.name: Switching contacts
parts.purpose: Contacts either connect or separate their terminal pairs. Their position is linked to the simulation state, including normally open and normally closed functions.
